purpose: Provenance record for bundled Dream Skin preset artwork.
generator: OpenAI built-in image generation, with user-provided artwork labeled per entry
provenance: Generated entries come from text-only prompts for this project. User-provided entries are explicitly labeled when their original provenance has not been independently verified.

promptPolicy.style: Premium contemporary Chinese 2D donghua key visual with clean expressive linework, polished cel shading, luminous atmospheric painting, and a cute high-appeal original character or Chinese landscape.
promptPolicy.composition: Wide cinematic 16:9 desktop theme; character on the right third with a calm low-detail left UI area, or a landscape with the same left-side readability.
promptPolicy.avoid: No real person, cosplay photography, Western comic or cyberpunk styling, existing franchise character, text, logo, or watermark.

thirdPartyFanArtPolicy.composition: Wide cinematic 16:9 desktop theme with recognizable characters on the right and a calm low-detail left UI area.
thirdPartyFanArtPolicy.avoid: No source-image copying, readable text, franchise logo, watermark, border, or UI mockup.

transformations: Each generated image is resized to 2560x1440, converted to JPEG, and configured as an adaptive Codex Dream Skin theme.
distributionNote: Bundled only as configured themes inside Codex Switch.
rightsNotice: Themes marked thirdPartyFanArt require permission from the applicable IP owners. User-provided artwork also requires the contributor to hold the necessary distribution rights.
